account.note: PULLED LIVE AT 09:42-09:47 ET AGAINST THE MANDATED ACCOUNT AFTER A SCOPE PREFLIGHT THAT MATCHED THE MANDATE IDENTIFIER EXACTLY AS A STRING against the connector list - no first-account default, no nickname match, no balance heuristic, exactly one match. Every other account was discarded unread and none is summarised, totalled or mentioned in this file, in runs.json, in why.json, in the commit message or in the operator report. Portfolio, equity positions and option positions were each queried live and all three returned first time: 1011.15 total against 1011.15 cash, zero equity value, zero options value, zero pending deposits, unsettled 0.0000 and buying_power 1011.15 to match. THE BALANCE MOVED FOR THE FIRST TIME SINCE 8/27 AND IT IS FLAGGED RATHER THAN ABSORBED: 1011.15 against the 1009.16 carried since 8/27, UP 1.99. No order of either kind on a 2026-08-26 created_at floor explains it - both order lists returned empty - and no position was opened or closed. The shape of it, a month-end credit of roughly 0.20% on an idle cash balance, is consistent with a cash-sweep interest posting, but this run did not find an endpoint that states that and does not assert it as fact. Sizing is done against the 1011.15 the broker returned, not against the carried number and not against a guess at its cause. The 8/10 precedent is the reason this is written down at all: a 900.00 difference was escalated rather than sized against, and the rule that produced that behaviour applies to a small difference too. THE WHOLE BALANCE IS SETTLED, so no good-faith violation is reachable. BOTH POSITION LISTS ARE EMPTY, so no target, no -8% equity stop, no -40% option stop, no ~5 session time stop and NO OPTION NO-FLY WINDOW is reachable - each checked and absent rather than skipped, and settled before any entry was reasoned about. ZERO orders of either kind on a 2026-08-26 floor independently confirms the flatness is not a stale read. || RE-VERIFIED LIVE BY THE 10:21 HOURLY AGAINST THE SAME MANDATED ACCOUNT AFTER ITS OWN SCOPE PREFLIGHT, AND NOTHING HAS MOVED: portfolio 1011.15 total against 1011.15 cash, equity_value 0, options_value 0, pending_deposits 0 and buying_power 1011.15 to match, with unsettled 0.0000 on the account record. The 1.99 credit that run flagged is STABLE rather than moving and remains flagged rather than explained: this run also found no endpoint asserting a cause and does not assert one. The whole balance is settled, so no good-faith violation is reachable, and the 385.20 claimed by the live DG specification is comfortably inside it.

entryWatch.setup: DG discount-retail reclaim - Dollar General reported fiscal Q2 2026 on 2026-08-27 am, EPS 2.23 against a 1.99 estimate, a 12.06% beat verified on a live per-symbol pull. The 8/27 gap was fully round-tripped by the 8/28 close of 122.89, eleven cents above the 122.78 pre-print close, and the name then RECLAIMED: 8/31 opened 123.47, held 122.725 and closed 126.75 for +3.14% on 4.19M shares against roughly 2M typical, taking back the 125.89 close of the reaction bar. Today has made three rising intraday lows - 126.24, 127.10, 128.19 - on accelerating volume of 38,659, 28,880 and 53,454 shares. SPECIFIED at 09:47 at a 128.40 limit for 3 shares, CLEAN, no checklist item marked fail. CONFIRMED at 10:22 by the hourly re-quote with the limit untouched; the deterioration is in fill probability, not in the thesis.
entryWatch.trigger: CONFIRMED LIVE AT 10:22 BY THE HOURLY RE-QUOTE, NOT KILLED, AND THE LIMIT IS UNCHANGED AT 128.40. DG is 130.37 bid / 130.55 ask at 2026-09-01T14:22:46.517881176Z, last 130.55, +2.86% against a 126.75 settled close, on a 0.18 spread or 0.138% of mark - tighter than the 0.31% quoted at strike. ALL THREE NAMED INVALIDATIONS CHECKED SEPARATELY. ONE, a trade below 126.24: NOT TRIGGERED, verified against the 13:30Z-14:15Z five-minute bars whose lows run 126.24, 127.10, 128.19, 128.375, 128.8155, 128.79, 129.115, 129.355, 129.795, 130.18 - 126.24 is still the session low and was set on the opening bar. The one blemish is recorded rather than smoothed: the 13:55Z bar's 128.79 low is 2.55 cents under the prior bar's 128.8155, a tick rather than a break, but it is a lower low. TWO, a close below 125.89: cannot fire until the close and is reported as PENDING, with DG 4.48 or 3.56% above it. THREE, the cohort failing: NOT TRIGGERED and stronger - DLTR 130.98 bid at +3.47% against +2.62% at strike, WMT 106.16 bid at +1.23% against +0.59%. THE MATERIAL CHANGE IS FILL PROBABILITY AND IT HAS WORSENED: the 128.40 limit sat 0.49 or 0.38% below the bid at 09:47 and now sits 1.97 or 1.51% below it, so it needs a 1.51% give-back rather than a 0.38% one. IT IS STILL NOT RAISED - widening the time was never permission to widen the price, and confirming a spec is not improving it. Expires 15:30 ET today.
entryWatch.why: Item 3 is na on a dated fact rather than skipped: DG's next report is 2026-12-03 on a live per-symbol pull, three months past the 9/8 time stop, so there is no earnings hold for a straddle to precede. moves.json branch one is checked and does not bind - it covers AVGO itself and semiconductor or enterprise-software sympathy names, and a discount retailer is neither. THE COHORT READ IS THE LOAD-BEARING PART AND IT IS A SPLIT, NOT A RALLY: DLTR +2.62%, WMT +0.59% and DG +1.69% bid while TJX -0.43%, ROST -0.74%, BURL -2.32%, WSM -2.58%, BBY -0.50%, ANF -0.41% and GAP -0.45% are red. Retail is not bouncing; deep-discount trade-down names are being bought on a second consecutive risk-off day. DG is the LAGGARD of the bid pair and the only one carrying a fresh catalyst, which is the sympathy-laggard setup the rulebook names. THE WEAKNESS, STATED BEFORE THE OUTCOME: this is a RECLAIM, not the day-2 continuation the rulebook prefers, because a fully round-tripped gap has no move left to continue. Yesterday this board refused DG in exactly those terms and took SJM instead; that refusal is confronted rather than reversed in silence, and what changed is two sessions of evidence. OPTIONS REFUSED ON SPREAD: the 3-6 week window on DG contains only weeklies - 9/18 is 2.4 weeks, 10/16 is 6.4 weeks, so both monthlies are excluded by the rule itself - and the tightest of eight near-money 10/02 calls quotes 40.6% of mark with zero volume, widening to 95.1%, while the 9/25 128c quotes 73.9%. Equity quotes 0.31%.

entryWatch.setup: SAIC day-2 after the 8/31 print - the name yesterday's file flagged as worth this open's attention if it built a shelf
entryWatch.trigger: REFUSED, AND IT FAILED IN FRONT OF THIS RUN RATHER THAN BEING DROPPED. SAIC is 124.36 bid / 125.31 ask at 2026-09-01T13:42:11.513Z, last 125.01, -3.01% against a 128.22 settled close. The 8/31 reaction bar opened 140.39, ran 142.66, printed a 127.10 low and closed 128.22 on 1.86M shares against roughly 400k typical - a gap-and-fade that gave back nearly all of an 11.5% pop. Today opened 127.01 and printed 124.05 within five minutes, so the name is now BELOW its own 125.96 pre-print close and BELOW yesterday's 127.10 low. A 30.9% beat has fully round-tripped in two sessions and there is still no shelf to strike a limit at. This is the NTNX gap-and-fade refusal of 8/27 applied again.
entryWatch.why: Recorded at length because it is the control case that gives DG's reclaim its meaning: two names, two round-tripped earnings gaps, and only one of them turned on rising volume. SAIC also had the larger beat, which is the point - the size of the beat did not decide the outcome and the tape did. The 0.95 spread on a 124.835 mark, 0.76%, is a second and independent mark against it.

entryWatch.setup: SJM breakout pullback - the 8/31 specification at a 132.10 limit, killed at 15:21 by the final hourly
entryWatch.trigger: NOT RE-STRUCK, AND THE REASON IS THE SETUP RATHER THAN THE PRICE. SJM is 131.80 bid / 132.40 ask at 2026-09-01T13:42:19.983Z, last 132.25, +0.49% against a 131.16 settled close, so the dead 132.10 limit is back inside the spread and could in principle be published again. It is not, because the thing that justified it is gone: the 8/31 bar made a lower low at 131.15 and a lower close at 131.16, breaking the rising-lows sequence of 128.12, 128.90, 131.10, 131.645 that was the entire technical case, and the relative-strength read failed outright on its eighth check at -0.816% against SPY -0.356%. A level that is available again is not the same as a setup that is still there.
entryWatch.why: Kept as the record of a distinction this board has to keep making: the 15:21 kill was mechanical, on the limit sitting above the offer, and was explicitly NOT the 131.10 invalidation firing. Today the invalidation still has not fired - the 8/31 low was 131.15, five cents above it - and the entry is still refused. That is the correct shape: a spec can die on price and the thesis can die separately and later, and blurring them is how a board talks itself back into a trade.

entryWatch.setup: SMTC day-2 after the 8/25 print - the 8/26 specification at a 138.50 limit that expired unexecuted
entryWatch.trigger: DEAD, AND THE REFUSAL PAYS FOR A THIRD CONSECUTIVE SESSION. SMTC is 125.00 bid / 125.46 ask at 2026-09-01T13:42:49.296Z, -5.99% against a 132.96 settled close. On 8/27 this board declined to re-strike the dead 138.50 limit up to 144.20; the name has since traded 131.17, 132.96 and now 125.00, so the refusal is worth 19.20 a share or 13.3% against the price the mandate would otherwise have paid. Still not bought - the semiconductor complex carries the 9/2 AVGO print inside any five-session hold opened today, under branch one.
entryWatch.why: Unchanged: a 24.6% beat on a name marked down 21.6% into its own print. Kept because the same rule that cost this board a filled BOX entry has now saved it 13.3% here, and a process that only counts the times a rule cost it is on its way to repealing the rule.

THE SECOND WEAKENING LIMB IS VOLUME: DG's advance from 128.50 to 130.55 has come on 19,611, 11,648, 9,156, 26,739, 18,636, 11,646 and 6,621 shares against the 38,659, 28,880 and 53,454 the entry described as accelerating. NO NEW ENTRY WAS PROPOSED AND NONE WAS SCREENED FOR - the daily mandate belongs to the open slot and was discharged there, this slot's default is no trade, and its bar for a mid-session entry is deliberately higher than the open's.

Second on what the bar is doing right now - it opened 94.00, printed 95.41 and has traded 92.50, giving back most of the pop inside seventeen minutes on 820k shares, which is a gap-and-fade in progress and the same refusal being applied to SAIC one row up. Worth the 9/2 and 9/3 opens' attention if it builds a shelf, on the same terms SAIC was given and failed.
